scope: Unverified summary of the headline national rules for a visiting hobby pilot. Commercial filming, local by-laws and site permissions are not covered.

registrationRequired.note: Every drone above 250 g needs a UIN on Digital Sky; foreign nationals cannot register in their own name and must go through an Indian entity.

pilotCertRequired.note: Depends on the aircraft and the operation; not established in this summary. Check the authority for pilot certification.

altitudeNote: General ceiling for hobby flights; lower limits apply near aerodromes and in restricted zones.
maxDistanceRule: Visual line of sight at all times.

insuranceRequired.note: Depends on the aircraft and the operation; not established in this summary. Check the authority for insurance.

importRestriction.note: Import requires DGCA approval; customs seizures of undeclared drones are common.

noFlyHighlights: Red zones around airports, borders and military areas
Delhi, Mumbai airports and much of the capital region
Monuments under the Archaeological Survey of India

cityNotes.note: Almost entirely red zone; no recreational flights.
Beaches are largely yellow/green but airport approaches at Dabolim and Mopa cut across them.
The Taj Mahal is a no-fly zone.

notes: Written from general knowledge on 2026-09-19 without fetching the sources; not verified. Confirm on the authority page before flying.
